text:
alex: Heads up — deploy-bot flagged a surge of 502s in ap-south canary after yesterday's values bump. db.pool.size went from 120 -> 5000 by values-sync.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary-unhealthy ap-south - 6/24 pods failing (502) - recent change values-sync-job-12 - CI/CD tag: rc-2024-07-21

teri: Is this limited to ap-south canary? any metric alarms in staging/prod?

jamal: only ap-south canary so far. dashboards show tcp connection queue length spiking and upstream returning 502 when pool saturates. looks like ephemeral burst handling regressed.

alex: we should do a targeted values revert for the canary and add a chart pin for the promotion candidate so it can't move forward with the bumped values. keep chart version pinned to previous stable for next promotion.

jamal: I'll apply a canary-only override configmap and restart the canary pods. command i'm going to run:

```
kubectl -n ap-south apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: myservice-canary-values
data:
  db.pool.size: "120"
EOF
kubectl -n ap-south rollout restart deployment/myservice-canary
```

ops-bot: noted. Creating ticket INF-4822 and setting promotion hold for this release candidate.

teri: alex, please update the release notes with "Values revert: db.pool.size reverted to 120 in ap-south canary; promotion on hold pending 30m stable health." Also request values-sync exemption for this chart group.

alex: done — release-notes updated and exemption requested in infra-configs. pinned candidate to myservice-chart v3.4.1 for next promotion if instability persists.

deploy-bot: action -> applied canary override; pinned rc -> chart v3.4.0; hold set; ticket INF-4822.

jamal: override applied, restart triggered. I'll monitor for 20m and post counts (502s, restarts). :eyes:

teri: good plan. if we see recovery then we unhold and allow promotion with pinned chart+values change gated by staged rollout and safety-window.

alex: sounds good. thanks everyone.
